class.name: synapticon_controllers/DriveController
class.description: Owns the state machines of the drives: takes drive action requests as services, reports every drive on ~/drive_status and /diagnostics, and stops the joints by itself when a drive faults, if so configured.

class.name: synapticon_controllers/EthercatBusMonitorController
class.description: Reports the health of the EtherCAT bus on /diagnostics: the link, the slaves that answer, their AL states and the working counter of the process data.

class.name: synapticon_controllers/MotorCommandController
class.description: Writes each synapticon_control_msgs/MotorCommand to the command interfaces of its joints: position, velocity, effort, stiffness and damping, the terms of the drive's impedance law.
